summary: Verified all 7 review items: (1) CompanyLogo renders on Login (2 imgs, no Leaf fallback) and (2) inside Sidebar after login (1 img, no fallback). (3) Admin login end-to-end works via plaintext POST /api/auth/simple-login (auth paths intentionally excluded from response encryption per payload_middleware.py); JWT (277 chars, 3-part) stored in sessionStorage, sanitized user (no password) in localStorage, navigates to /dashboard. (4) Bill Generate header shows billNumber 'EPS000410' exactly — confirmed via DOM scan (regex EPS\d{6}). (5) AES-GCM response encryption regression: GET /api/company and GET /api/bills return {__enc:1, iv, ct} with header x-payload-encrypted:1, AES-GCM-decrypted client-side using REACT_APP_PAYLOAD_KEY; PUT /api/company round-trips correctly; no JSON-parse errors in console. (6) My Account uses PhoneInput with country selector — screenshot confirms 🇮🇳 +91 flag dropdown plus separate phone digits field, format hint shows '+918105004458'. (7) No 'cashless' text anywhere on Bill Generate page. Bills collection is empty in DB so client-side generateBillNumber() = EPS{max(409, ...nums)+1} = EPS000410. Backend pytest suite: 8/8 pass.

critical_code_review_comments: payload_middleware.py correctly skips /api/auth/* + /api/seed + /api/health + /api/ws and encrypts everything else under /api/. Verified by header x-payload-encrypted:1 on /api/company & /api/bills, and absent on /api/auth/simple-login.
CompanyLogo fallback logic is sound: useState(failed) flips to Leaf on img onError, plus trims logoUrl before checking. DEFAULT_COMPANY.logoUrl points to a working CDN (200 OK in browser).

BILL_START_SEQ=410 with Math.max(BILL_START_SEQ-1, ...nums)+1 correctly yields EPS000410 for empty bills array AND continues monotonic numbering once bills exist. Pad-6 zero-fill verified visually on Bill Generate header.
AppContext.js is now ~1020 lines and growing — consider splitting bill/customer/company slices into separate context providers or zustand stores for maintainability.
